description: Angular component for an aggregated value card widget in the Thingsboard UI, including chart rendering, data updates, styling, and layout management.

classes.name: AggregatedValueCardWidgetComponent
classes.description: Angular component implementing an aggregated value card with chart, data display, and styling features.

methods.name: ngOnInit
methods.description: Initializes component settings, subtitle, chart, and layout after component creation.

methods.name: ngAfterViewInit
methods.description: Sets up chart and layout adjustments after view initialization.

methods.name: ngOnDestroy
methods.description: Cleans up resources such as resize observers and chart instances.

methods.name: onDataUpdated
methods.description: Handles updates when data changes, updating chart and timestamps.

methods.name: onLatestDataUpdated
methods.description: Updates displayed values and arrows based on latest data.

methods.name: updateLastUpdateTs
methods.description: Updates the last update timestamp and refreshes date formatting.

methods.name: onValueCardValuesResize
methods.description: Adjusts layout and scaling of value display based on container size.
